Typed ACSet: an ACSet with a typing morphism to a type system

Source: R/typed_acsets.R
TypedACSet.Rd

A TypedACSet pairs an ACSet X with a morphism phi: X -> T where T is the "type system" (another ACSet on the same schema). Every element in X is assigned a type by phi.

Usage

TypedACSet(
  acset = acsets::ACSet(),
  type_system = acsets::ACSet(),
  typing = ACSetTransformation()
)

Arguments

acset

The ACSet instance

type_system

The type system ACSet

typing

An ACSetTransformation from acset to type_system
